description:
search_snippet.rs:30-36

  pub async fn search_snippet_get(
      &self,
      account_id: Option<&Id>,
      filter: serde_json::Value,
      thread_ids: Option<&[Id]>,
      email_ids: Option<&[Id]>,
  ) -> Result<serde_json::Value, jmap_base_client::ClientError>

The function returns serde_json::Value with a docstring saying:

  "Callers should deserialize into Vec<jmap_mail_types::SearchSnippet> via
   response["list"].as_array()."

jmap_mail_types::SearchSnippet already exists and matches the spec wire shape (visible in the response_deserializes test in search_snippet.rs:99). The justification given in the file header comment is:

  "We therefore return serde_json::Value and let the caller deserialize.
   ... the response shape differs from the standard /get shape
   (no `state` field, no `notFound`)."

That justification does not survive scrutiny. The fact that SearchSnippet/get has a non-standard response shape is not a reason to skip typing it — it is a reason to define a non-standard typed response shape. A reasonable design:

  #[non_exhaustive]
  #[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize)]
  #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
  pub struct SearchSnippetGetResponse {
      pub account_id: Id,
      pub list: Vec<SearchSnippet>,
      #[serde(default, flatten, skip_serializing_if = "serde_json::Map::is_empty")]
      pub extra: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
  }

  pub async fn search_snippet_get(...) -> Result<SearchSnippetGetResponse, ClientError>

This:
  - Eliminates the per-caller `response["list"].as_array()` boilerplate (defensive-code-forcing today).
  - Encodes the spec's documented response shape in the type system.
  - Follows the workspace extras-preservation policy with the `extra` flatten field.
  - Allows downstream extension via #[non_exhaustive] without breaking callers.

Cross-reference: JMAP-tjvm.6 is filing the thread_ids parameter as a separate spec-correctness bug. The signature change there might or might not be merged before this one. If thread_ids stays as a documented vendor extension per RFC 8621 §5.1, the typed response can land independently.

Recommendation: define SearchSnippetGetResponse, change the return type, deprecate the Value return. Major-version-breaking for callers but trivially mechanical migration (one `.list` access path stays the same, only the `as_array()` boilerplate goes away).

Mark says NO HUMAN — I have a clear recommendation: type the response, no design ambiguity.
title: search_snippet_get returns serde_json::Value — typed SearchSnippet exists in jmap-mail-types and is unused
